Start of the lower 16-byte strip for phase zero. When X advances by $20 the same read fetches the lower strip of phase one.
Sets up a new session, requests music selection $0C and enters the title menu. On exit changes music request to $08 and falls into mission setup.
Shows the briefing, sets energy to $1F and builds the room and its entity slots. Transfers the mission time into $18 and clears the lower timer counters before entering the play loop.

Runs queued redraws, polls the stop key via CIA1, updates room state and draws panel changes. Returns with $5F set to 0 for the stop key, 1 for exhausted time, 2 for depleted energy or 4 when the target count reaches zero.

Marks a transition in $C0, calls the destination menu and rebuilds the surrounding entity slots. Redraws the room, then clears the request at $21 and the transition flag.

Pointer bytes for the second sprite staging set. $5BA2 transfers the six values to $89 onwards.
Sets Y coordinates in both raster bands, installs their frame pointers, clears the top of the six sprite work pairs and initializes their flags.
Five word targets indexed by the return code at $5F. The jump at $5C16 is patched to the selected target.
High byte of the first word of mission exit dispatch. $5C10 applies the same even index to this byte as the matching low-byte read.
Stops the gameplay raster split and jumps to the exit path indexed by $5F via the table at $5BF8.
Patched low byte of the selected exit handler read at $5C0A.
The matching high byte from $5BF9 for the mission exit jump at $5C16.

Displays and adds the mission bonus, then enters the next briefing through $5A8D.
Scans the $30-$5F slot window at $FF14 and reloads each occupied entry through $6069.
Running counter whose low four bits select the changing colour attribute on the panel.
Increments an animation phase and writes $10 combined with its low nibble to eight panel screen cells.

A selects a shape pointer from $1F06, X supplies the packed placement coordinates, and $3F reverses the position within an eight-column band. Copies shape attributes and bitmap bytes into room buffers according to the descriptor header.
Byte written from the descriptor style's low nibble by $5D40. $5D47 loads this value before filling each row of the shape's colour staging cells.
Patched with the full second descriptor byte. The high nibble selects the uniform screen attribute path.

Disables sprites and the raster split, clears previous output and draws the base layout, room overlay and destination details. Waits for the raster handler to clear $60 before committing 800 screen and colour cells and enabling the split.

Looks up the current layout in the directory at $6393. A selector with its high bit set enables reversal in $3F and chooses layout index $0B through the operand at $5EC3.
Holds the current layout index with bit 7 removed. The instruction runs when $5EAF enables reversed placement positions.
Reads a count from ($02), then decodes that many two-byte placements. Calls $5CAC with the packed coordinate in X and shape index in A.

Zeros twelve 160-byte spans distributed across the two halves of the room bitmap before the next shape list is drawn.
